title: NHTSA oblique offset frontal research reference — test 7441

source.report: Integrated Vehicle and Occupant Modeling for Crashworthiness

reference_vehicle.usage: External protocol/load-case evidence only; the named test vehicle is not exposed as a CrashVector production model.

test_condition.impact: oblique offset frontal impact with research moving deformable barrier

published_observations.notes: DOT HS 812 087 identifies the 90 km/h, 15-degree, 35-percent-overlap oblique load case and NHTSA test 7441. CrashVector does not import occupant injury measures or use them as structural acceptance corridors.

scope.required_model_gap: A research moving deformable barrier and validated oblique/offset contact geometry are not implemented as a production target.
scope.warning: This reference records a public NHTSA load case. It is not evidence that CrashVector currently reproduces test 7441 outcomes, occupant response, or manufacturer-specific structure.
